## Cracking demo (hash → plaintext)

Target: `SHA-256("hi") = 8f434346648f6b96df89dda901c5176b10a6d83961dd3c1ac88b59b2dc327aa4`

```
Cracking with SHA-256 (printable ASCII 32-127, length 1-10)
Splitting the search space across 12 threads, 4096 candidates per work item.
Trying length 1...
Trying length 2...

============================================
 Match found
============================================
 Plain Text : "hi"
 Algorithm  : SHA-256
 Attempts   : 8106
============================================
```

> Tip for class: hash `a`, `ab`, `abc` with MD5/SHA-256/SHA3-256 and show how
> length + alphabet size explode the crack time. Then hash `hello` vs `hell0`
> to show the avalanche effect.
